description: Monthly payroll employer cost should reconcile to ledger accounts 5001-5005 within INR 0.01.
recommended_action: Review the affected posting period and payroll/ledger source rows.

description: Each journal entry must have equal total debits and credits within INR 0.005.
recommended_action: Reject the unbalanced entry and alert the ledger owner.

description: One payroll row per employee per run.
recommended_action: Trace and remove the duplicate payroll row after source review.

description: Every payroll employee_id must exist in dim_employee.
recommended_action: Fix the key or load the missing employee record.

description: Attendance month should not fall after the employee exit month.
recommended_action: Ask HR to confirm the exit date and attendance entry.

description: Unpaid absence days in attendance should be reflected in payroll LOP days for the same employee-month (0.5-day tolerance).
recommended_action: Review unpaid-leave mapping and the payroll deduction run.

description: Invoice paid amount must not exceed total and balance due must not be negative.
recommended_action: Correct the invoice payment or total using the supporting receipt.

description: Total expense should equal amount excluding GST plus GST within INR 0.01.
recommended_action: Correct the vendor bill arithmetic using the source invoice.

description: Completion cannot be before start, and Done tasks require a completion date.
recommended_action: Ask the team to repair the task board dates/status.

description: Leave end date must be on or after start date.
recommended_action: Verify the original leave request and date keys; do not auto-swap dates.

description: Attrition risk predictions should be within seven days of the newest batch in this static dataset.
recommended_action: Ask the AI team to refresh stale predictions and record the model batch.

description: Employee effective-date intervals must not overlap across versions.
recommended_action: Close the previous version before the next version's valid_from.

description: The latest successful pipeline run should be no more than 24 hours old.
recommended_action: Check scheduler status, source availability, and the latest run log.

description: Metric values and sensitive supporting aggregates must be suppressed below the applicable minimum group size.
recommended_action: Suppress the cell or roll up to a larger group before display.
